source.title: Lower limb kinematic, kinetic, and EMG data from young healthy humans during walking at controlled speeds
source.authors: Moreira, Figueiredo, Fonseca, Vilas-Boas and Santos
source.method: Measured sagittal joint angles and EMG envelopes from left stride 1 and right strides 1–2, resampled to the left heel-to-heel cycle. Each published stance and swing trace is aligned to the corresponding 20 N vertical force-plate transition. Pelvis travel is the mean of four ASIS/PSIS markers relative to the cycle start.
source.angles: Degrees. Hip and knee flexion and ankle dorsiflexion are positive.
source.emg: Surface EMG envelope as percent of each channel's maximum voluntary contraction. Missing muscles were not recorded.
